# Devniques

> Devniques offers MDM, AI automation and chatbots, custom software, websites and apps — digital solutions that simplify operations and help your business grow.

Devniques is an IT services and technology company in Karachi, Pakistan. Its work is built around driving digital growth with smart technology solutions.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://devniques.com/): Devniques – Smart Technology Solutions.
- [Devniques MDM](https://devniques.com/devniques-mdm/): Mobile Device Management (MDM) for businesses.
- [AI Automation & Chatbots](https://devniques.com/ai-automation/): AI automation and chatbots, from everyday tasks to intelligent workflows.
- [Blog](https://devniques.com/blog/): What Devniques does, in short.
- [Book Your MDM Demo](https://devniques.com/mdm-demo/): Book a demo of Devniques MDM.
- [Contact Us](https://devniques.com/contact/): Contact Devniques and request a quote.

## Services

- [Custom Software](https://devniques.com/#products): Custom software, websites and mobile apps — engineered for performance and designed for growth.
- [Website Development](https://devniques.com/#products): Custom web development solutions engineered for performance, scalability, and business growth.
- [Digital Marketing](https://devniques.com/#products): Result-driven digital marketing and SEO strategies tailored to your business — drive traffic, increase visibility, and grow your brand.
- [ERP & CRM Systems](https://devniques.com/#products): Bring inventory, payroll, sales and customer relationships together in one connected system. Your entire business. One clear view.

## Products

- [Devniques MDM](https://devniques.com/devniques-mdm/): Manage and secure phones, tablets, laptops and POS devices from one console — enrollment, policies, apps and remote lock/wipe. One Platform. Total Device Control. Enterprise-Grade Security.
- [Buzzflo Suite](https://devniques.com/#products): Part of the Devniques product suite.
- [Signvero](https://devniques.com/#products): Part of the Devniques product suite.
- [Post Marrow Email](https://devniques.com/#products): Devniques email product.
- [Microsoft 365](https://devniques.com/#products): Microsoft 365 products and services offered by Devniques.
- [Hospital Management](https://devniques.com/#products): Management software for hospitals and healthcare operations.
- [Itmenaan](https://devniques.com/#products): Part of the Devniques product suite.
- [TrackOnMoves Fleet](https://devniques.com/#products): Fleet tracking and management.
- [Ship Flow Logistics](https://devniques.com/#products): Logistics and shipment flow management.
